tips.text: Keep a solo clan at Ghost tier; research costs multiply with each tier above it.
Queue Nami Skyla and Endura research back to back and gather materials while the timers run.
Donate the research materials to the clan vault first; research draws from it.
Rank Nami Skyla too if you want it; it is only a prerequisite but gives its own Mastery.
Gather the Argon Crystals last, right before the build; they halve at each daily reset.
Players rarely discuss the farm because it is trivial; most want it only for Mastery.
